from pathlib import Path
from ctypes import wintypes
import ctypes,datetime,hashlib,json,os,sys
k=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
k.GetVolumeInformationW.argtypes=[wintypes.LPCWSTR,wintypes.LPWSTR,wintypes.DWORD,ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD),ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD),ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD),wintypes.LPWSTR,wintypes.DWORD];k.GetVolumeInformationW.restype=wintypes.BOOL
name=ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(256);fs=ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(256);serial=wintypes.DWORD();maximum=wintypes.DWORD();flags=wintypes.DWORD();assert k.GetVolumeInformationW('C:'+chr(92),name,256,ctypes.byref(serial),ctypes.byref(maximum),ctypes.byref(flags),fs,256)
e=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=e.parents[1];profile=json.loads((root/'docs/specifications/windows/native-mapped-filename/profile-29704-v1.json').read_text());providers=[]
for provider in profile['providers']:
 p=Path(provider['path']);observed=hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest();assert observed==provider['sha256'];providers.append({'arch':provider['arch'],'path':str(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':observed})
data={'kernel':list(sys.getwindowsversion()[:3]),'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'native_pid':os.getpid(),'volume_root':'C:'+chr(92),'filesystem':fs.value,'volume_serial':serial.value,'provider_identities':providers,'scope':'Read-only post-capture volume and NTDLL identity check; no intervening changes to native control files'};assert data['kernel']==[10,0,29704]and fs.value=='NTFS';(e/'paired-volume-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(data))
